name: @pipeworx/mcp-cactus

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: NCI CACTUS chemical identifier resolver. Convert one chemical identifier (a drug/chemical name, CAS number, SMILES, InChI, or InChIKey) into a single representation: smiles (canonical SMILES), stdinchi (standard InChI), stdinchikey (standard InChIKey), iupac_name, names (synonym list), formula (molecular formula), mw (molecular weight), or cas (CAS registry number(s)). Keyless, plain-text API.

identifier.description: Chemical name, CAS number, SMILES, InChI, or InChIKey (e.g. "aspirin", "50-78-2", "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(O)=O").

representation.description: One of: smiles, stdinchi, stdinchikey, iupac_name, names, formula, mw, cas.

tools.name: identify
tools.description: NCI CACTUS one-shot lookup: given any chemical identifier (name, CAS, SMILES, InChI, or InChIKey), return SMILES, InChIKey, IUPAC name, molecular formula, molecular weight, and CAS number in a single call. Fields that cannot be resolved are returned as null. Keyless, plain-text API.

identifier.description: Chemical name, CAS number, SMILES, InChI, or InChIKey (e.g. "ibuprofen", "15687-27-1").

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cactus forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cactus pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
